subject: self.root / human-surface Frank v0.1

internal_evidence.observed_gap: ProductStart requires trusted builder/artifact attestation, but PR#231 remains BLOCKED_NO_TRUSTED_BUILDER / BLOCKED_NO_ATTESTATION_VERIFIER. PR#229 is capability-only and does not select production trust policy.

fresh_primary_external_evidence.source: GitHub Docs: Using artifact attestations to establish provenance for builds
fresh_primary_external_evidence.finding: Artifact attestations are available for private/internal repositories only on GitHub Enterprise Cloud; Free/Pro/Team support is public-repository-only.

Current GitHub attestation action binds artifact name/digest to an in-toto predicate; private/internal repositories use GitHub's private Sigstore instance and verification is supported through GitHub CLI.
Offline verification requires artifact + bundle + trusted root + GitHub CLI; trusted roots must be refreshed over time as Sigstore key material rotates.

Official installer currently documents GitHub-hosted runners as supported and warns that self-hosted runners may not work; therefore installer presence cannot be assumed as a production target invariant.

hypothesis: Frank ProductStart build provenance should be decomposed into independently testable trust axes: owner-pinned builder/source policy, cryptographically verified provenance, exact artifact-subject digest binding, local installed-byte equality, and state-lineage/identity/recovery conjunction. No builder/workflow identity alone may admit an artifact.
strongest_counterhypothesis: A simpler trusted deployment channel plus exact local artifact hash may be sufficient for v0.1, making an additional general-purpose attestation verifier unnecessary. This remains unproven because a local hash without an independently trusted producer does not establish who built the bytes or from what source, and the current ProductStart contract explicitly requires trusted builder/provenance evidence.

live_adjudication.reason: Current GitHub primary documentation makes private-repository artifact attestations Enterprise-Cloud-only, matching the prior measured native-attestation blocker class. Current repository plan/Enterprise entitlement was not independently queried by this worker, so the claim is bounded to the documented feature requirement plus prior project execution evidence.
live_adjudication.reason_sigstore: Keyless public Sigstore may expose signing identity/provenance in public transparency infrastructure and represents a production trust/privacy choice; this worker does not mint that owner decision.

oob_experiment.name: ATTESTATION_SUBJECT_SWAP
oob_experiment.setup: Generate ephemeral Ed25519 key; sign provenance metadata for artifact A including repository, main ref, signer-workflow identity and exact SHA-256 subject digest. Construct different artifact B. Compare a deliberately unsafe verifier that validates signature/repository/workflow but ignores subject digest against a subject-bound verifier that also hashes the candidate bytes.

resource_shadow.interpretation: Local synthetic microbenchmark only; tiny artifact payloads and ephemeral key. It measures the falsifier implementation, not target ProductStart latency.

oob_experiment.rollback: No repository target state, production key, VPS install, canonical Frank state or external service was modified by the experiment.

architecture_delta.change: Represent ProductStart build trust as a conjunctive BuildTrustBundle with at least: trusted_policy_id, canonical_repository, source_digest/ref, signer/builder identity, crypto_verification_receipt, subject_sha256, local_installed_sha256, verifier/trust-root version, and freshness/rollback state. Exact subject digest equality is mandatory and cannot be substituted by a trusted signer identity.
do_not_do: Do not treat a trusted workflow name as sufficient artifact identity.
Do not treat a local hash as provenance without an independently trusted producer/verification chain.
Do not automatically select public Sigstore keyless signing for a private Frank release without an owner-fixed privacy/trust decision.
Do not claim GitHub-native private artifact attestations are available unless current account/plan capability is explicitly verified.
next_discriminators_ranked: Verify current repository/account entitlement for GitHub private artifact attestations directly; if unavailable, close GitHub-native branch as NOT_AVAILABLE rather than retrying gh installation.
Execute or supersede PR#229 only as a verifier-capability probe; capability alone must not choose trust policy.

Design two owner-reviewable production trust candidates: offline-pinned verifier+roots versus owner-held signing key/public-key pin, each with rotation/revocation/recovery semantics and no secret committed to Git.

After owner selects a trust policy, compose exact artifact subject verification with V4 storage admission + selected state-lineage + canonical ProductStart entrypoint and execute installed stop/start/crash-restart on exact bytes.

research_reentry.reason_no_target_patch: The highest-value uncertainty is an owner-governed production trust-policy selection plus current feature entitlement. Implementing a signer or committing private key material without that authority would be unsafe and would create false completion.
